title: Nepal at a Glance
notes:
Nepal at a Glance

  • Area: 147,516 sq. km.
  • Capital: Kathmandu.
  • Currency: Nepalese Rupee (NPR).
  • National bird: Danphe (Lophophorus) · National animal: Cow.
  • National flower: Rhododendron (Laligurans) · National anthem: “Sayaun Thunga Phool Ka” by Pradeep Kumar Rai (Byakul Maila).
  • Highest peak: Mount Everest (8,848.86 m) · Rivers: Koshi, Gandaki (Narayani), Karnali — Nepal's three major river systems.
  • Time zone: UTC +5:45 · First census year: 1968 BS (1911 AD); latest census 2078 BS (2021) — the 12th national census.

Geography

Nepal is divided into three ecological belts: Terai (plains), Hilly (mid-hills), and Himalayan (mountains). It shares borders with India (south, east, west) and China (north).
